proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865 subsection 2 khādita explicitly supplies Nepali khāyo and describes analogical past formations Sindhi khādho, Lahnda/Punjabi khādhā and Gujarati khādhũ, with Old Marathi khādilā. The selected khad-/khaḍ- and Dotyali khāⁱyo eating responses belong to that past-stem family. Survey dental/retroflex notation, aspiration, vowel quantity and regional l-extensions remain unchanged and are qualifications; no exact phonological derivation or direct borrowing route is asserted. Exact response: khaḍu.
